# Mailbox Atlas

> Virtual mailbox prices, scan and forwarding fees, and USPS Form 1583 rules compared, with a source link on every number.

Mailbox Atlas is an independent reference site published by Atlas Guides. Every fee, rule and coverage claim links to the statute, government office or provider page it came from, and each page shows the date it was last checked. Where a figure could not be confirmed on a source page, the table shows a dash instead of a guess. Some outbound links are affiliate links; they are labeled and never change what a page says.

Last updated: 2026-11-28

## Guides

- [Can You Use a Virtual Mailbox Address on a U.S. Passport Application or Renewal?](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-passport-application/): What the DS-11 and DS-82 passport forms say about the mailing address and the permanent address, the online-renewal address rule, and how to receive a new passport at a virtual mailbox without it being opened or shredded. Checked Nov 28, 2026. (checked 2026-11-28)
- [Shopping U.S. Stores From Abroad With a Virtual Mailbox: Package Consolidation and Forwarding Fees](https://mailboxatlas.com/shop-us-stores-from-abroad/): Ship U.S. online orders to a virtual mailbox and have them repacked into one international box. Consolidation fees: Traveling Mailbox $0 (postage + $2 per shipment), US Global Mail $5 per box, iPostal1 $1.95 per package, Virtual Post Mail $3.75 per package handling. Customs rules and what gets opened. Checked Nov 28, 2026. (checked 2026-11-28)
- [Switching Virtual Mailbox Locations (or When Yours Closes): New Form 1583, Overlap, and Old Mail](https://mailboxatlas.com/switch-virtual-mailbox-location/): Moving to a different address at the same provider usually means a new account and a new Form 1583, and USPS won't forward mail from one mailbox to another. Rules at US Global Mail, Traveling Mailbox, Virtual Post Mail and iPostal1, plus what happened when a location closed. Checked Nov 28, 2026. (checked 2026-11-28)
- [Virtual Mailbox Shredding Fees and Policies by Provider](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-mail-shredding/): Shredding is free at Traveling Mailbox, US Global Mail, Virtual Post Mail, Stable, LegalZoom Virtual Mail and PhysicalAddress.com. iPostal1 charges $2.25 per shred order and PostScan Mail $1 per item. Some providers also shred mail automatically after 30 days. Checked Nov 28, 2026. (checked 2026-11-28)
- [Who Opens Your Mail at a Virtual Mailbox? Security and Privacy by Provider](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-security-privacy/): Who handles your mail, when envelopes get opened, where shredding happens, and how accounts are protected at US Global Mail, Traveling Mailbox, Virtual Post Mail, Stable, LegalZoom Virtual Mail, PostScan Mail, Anytime Mailbox and iPostal1. From each provider's own security pages, checked Nov 28, 2026. (checked 2026-11-28)
- [Can a Virtual Mailbox Receive Amazon, UPS and FedEx Packages? Carriers, Size Limits and Package Fees by Provider](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-packages/): Every major virtual mailbox accepts packages from UPS, FedEx and DHL as well as USPS. The differences are size limits (Traveling Mailbox takes no freight; PostScan charges $0.25/lb over 25 lbs), free package storage (3 days to 30 days) and where to ship. Provider by provider, checked Nov 27, 2026. (checked 2026-11-27)
- [Can You Put a Virtual Mailbox Address on Your Driver's License? Texas, Florida and South Dakota Rules](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-drivers-license/): A REAL ID license needs two documents showing your principal residence, so a virtual mailbox usually can't be your license address. Texas wants a Texas residence address and rejects mail with a forwarding label; Florida wants two documents with a Florida residential address; South Dakota accepts a mail-forwarding PMB for full-time travelers with an affidavit. Checked Nov 27, 2026. (checked 2026-11-27)
- [Can You Use a Virtual Mailbox Address for Stripe or Amazon Seller Verification?](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-address-stripe-amazon/): Stripe asks for the physical place where most of your business activity happens and says private mailboxes are not accepted; Issuing, Treasury and Opal screen out mailbox and virtual addresses automatically. Amazon wants the address on your business license plus proof of a residential address. What each actually says, checked Nov 27, 2026. (checked 2026-11-27)
- [Can You Use a Virtual Mailbox for a Google Business Profile? What Google's Rules Say](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-google-business-profile/): No. Google's Business Profile guidelines say "P.O. boxes or mailboxes located at remote locations aren't acceptable" and that a rented mailing address you don't operate from is not eligible. What service-area businesses should do instead, and what staffed virtual offices and co-working spaces need. Checked Nov 27, 2026. (checked 2026-11-27)
- [Monthly vs Annual Virtual Mailbox Plans: What the Yearly Price Actually Saves](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-annual-vs-monthly/): Paying yearly saves $20.88 on iPostal1's $9.99 plan, $48 to $360 at US Global Mail, $120 to $192 at Stable and $20 to $60 at PostScan Mail. Traveling Mailbox gives 2 months free and prorates refunds; US Global Mail and Stable don't refund after 30 days. Break-even months and refund rules, checked Nov 27, 2026. (checked 2026-11-27)
- [Anytime Mailbox vs PostScan Mail: Operator-Set Plans vs One Price List](https://mailboxatlas.com/anytime-mailbox-vs-postscan-mail/): Anytime Mailbox plans are set by each mail center (from $4.99 a month); PostScan Mail sells the same three plans everywhere at $10 to $65 by address. What each charges to open, forward and store mail, with a 20-letter worked example. Checked Nov 25, 2026. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [Can You Pick Up Mail In Person From a Virtual Mailbox? Pickup Rules and Fees by Provider](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-in-person-pickup/): Some virtual mailboxes let you walk in and collect mail; others never do. US Global Mail charges $5 for letters and $15+ for packages, iPostal1 and PostScan Mail are free at most locations, Anytime Mailbox depends on the operator, and Stable and Virtual Post Mail don't allow pickup. Checked Nov 25, 2026. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [How Long Virtual Mailboxes Keep Your Mail: Free Storage Days and Fees](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-storage-fees/): Free physical storage for letters and packages at eight virtual mailbox providers, what they charge after that, and what happens when storage ends or you cancel. From 3 days (PostScan Mail packages, monthly plan) to 60 days (US Global Mail Teams). Checked Nov 23, 2026. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [How to Cancel a Virtual Mailbox, and What Happens to Mail That Arrives After](https://mailboxatlas.com/cancel-virtual-mailbox/): USPS won't forward mail away from a virtual mailbox, and mail keeps arriving for months. How to cancel at nine providers, what each does with stored mail and with mail that arrives after you close, and the fees (from free to a $50 wind-down plan). Checked Nov 25, 2026. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [How to Write a Virtual Mailbox Address: PMB, #, or Suite?](https://mailboxatlas.com/how-to-write-virtual-mailbox-address/): USPS rules say mail to a virtual mailbox must carry "PMB" or "#" before your box number, and that any other word is prohibited. The two USPS formats, the rule for buildings that already have a suite number, and why some providers print "Suite" anyway. Checked Nov 25, 2026. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [iPostal1 vs Traveling Mailbox: $9.99 vs $15, and Which Is Cheaper Once You Open Mail](https://mailboxatlas.com/ipostal1-vs-traveling-mailbox/): iPostal1 starts at $9.99 a month but charges $2.25 to open each letter; Traveling Mailbox starts at $15 with 35 page scans included. Fee by fee, with worked examples at 2 and 10 opened letters a month, from both companies' own pages. Checked Nov 25, 2026. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [PhysicalAddress.com Pricing: Plans From $7.98, Locations and Fees (2026)](https://mailboxatlas.com/physicaladdress-pricing/): PhysicalAddress.com Plan 30 starts at $7.98 a month with 30 envelope scans and 10 content scans. Published plan prices, city starting prices, storage, forwarding, Form 1583 and the free registered agent, copied from PhysicalAddress.com on November 25, 2026. (checked 2026-11-25)

Which one is cheapest depends on how much mail you open. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [Virtual Mailbox Check Deposit Fees Compared: Free, $3, $4.95 or $10 a Check](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-check-deposit-fees/): What it costs to have a virtual mailbox deposit a paper check: US Global Mail (no handling fee), Stable (from $3/check), Traveling Mailbox ($4.95 + postage), iPostal1 ($4.95 per 5 checks), Earth Class Mail ($10, or $39/mo for 5). From each provider's own page. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [Virtual Mailbox Mail Forwarding Fees Compared: Per Shipment vs Per Item](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-forwarding-fees/): What virtual mailbox providers charge to forward mail, on top of postage: Traveling Mailbox $2 per shipment, PostScan Mail $2 plus $0.50 per extra item, LegalZoom Virtual Mail $1.25 per shipment plus $1 per item, US Global Mail, Stable and PhysicalAddress.com no published handling fee. With a worked 10-letter example. Checked Nov 23, 2026. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [Virtual Mailbox Pricing Compared: Plans, Scan Fees and Form 1583 (2026)](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-pricing-comparison/): Nine virtual mailbox services side by side: monthly price, mail included, scan and overage fees, forwarding fees, and whether you need a notary for USPS Form 1583. Every number links to the provider page it came from. (checked 2026-11-25)
- [Does Junk Mail Count Toward Your Virtual Mailbox Limit? Provider Rules Compared](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-junk-mail/): Junk mail is free at Traveling Mailbox, Stable, LegalZoom Virtual Mail, Virtual Post Mail and most iPostal1 locations, but counts toward your limit at PostScan Mail ($0.50 per extra item). Each provider’s rule and overage fee, checked Nov 24, 2026. (checked 2026-11-24)
- [Form 1583 Rejected? The Common Reasons and How to Fix Each One](https://mailboxatlas.com/form-1583-rejected/): Why virtual mailbox providers reject Form 1583 or its IDs: a name or address that doesn’t match the ID, an expired or unreadable ID, one license used as both IDs, a document USPS doesn’t accept, or a blank business section. The USPS rule behind each, the fix, and how long re-review takes. Checked Nov 24, 2026. (checked 2026-11-24)
- [HIPAA-Compliant Virtual Mailbox: Which Providers Sign a BAA, and on Which Plan](https://mailboxatlas.com/hipaa-compliant-virtual-mailbox/): Four virtual mailbox providers publish a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement option: Virtual Post Mail from $60/mo, PostScan Mail as a $25/mo add-on, and Stable and US Global Mail on custom or enterprise plans. What each includes, from their own pages on Nov 24, 2026. (checked 2026-11-24)
- [How to Change Your Address to a Virtual Mailbox: USPS Change of Address, Form 1583 and What Isn’t Forwarded](https://mailboxatlas.com/change-address-to-virtual-mailbox/): The order that works: get your Form 1583 approved, then file a USPS change of address ($1.25 online ID check), then update banks, the IRS and other senders directly. Temporary vs permanent forwarding, what USPS won’t forward, and why you can’t forward mail away from a virtual mailbox later. Checked Nov 24, 2026. (checked 2026-11-24)

Checked Nov 24, 2026. (checked 2026-11-24)
- [USPS Form 1583 for a Business: Who Signs, Which IDs, and Extra Business Names](https://mailboxatlas.com/form-1583-for-business/): For a business mailbox, an officer signs Form 1583 and gives their title, the officer’s two IDs cover the company, and section 7 asks for the business name, type, street address and place of registration. Each business name needs its own form; what providers charge per extra name. Checked Nov 24, 2026. (checked 2026-11-24)

PDF plus Excel files. (checked 2026-11-23)

Davinci prices each address separately ($50 to $200/mo in Houston, Miami and Los Angeles) plus a setup fee and a 6-month term. Side by side, with first-year costs. Checked Nov 23, 2026. Free, runs in your browser. (checked 2026-11-23)
- [Virtual Office vs Virtual Mailbox: What the Extra Money Buys](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-office-vs-virtual-mailbox/): A virtual mailbox gives you a street address and scanned mail from about $10 to $20 a month. A virtual office adds a phone line, receptionist, lobby listing or meeting rooms for $40 to $200 a month, often with a setup fee and a minimum term. Prices from iPostal1, Opus, Davinci, Traveling Mailbox and Virtual Post Mail, checked Nov 23, 2026. (checked 2026-11-23)
- [Can I Use a Virtual Mailbox Address for My Bank Account?](https://mailboxatlas.com/virtual-mailbox-for-bank-account/): Usually as a mailing address, rarely as your home or business street address. What the federal bank ID rule (31 CFR 1020.220) asks for, what Mercury accepts in each address field, and what US Global Mail, Stable and Virtual Post Mail tell their own customers.
